name: PC Luxury Furniture Store
headline: Interior Design Company in Dubai Turning Ideas Into Refined Interiors
lede: PC Interiors is a luxury interior design company in Dubai offering turnkey fit-out, joinery and landscaping for villas and offices. Book now.
about: We are Perfect Creations, a Dubai team that believes a home should feel as good as it looks. Founded by Mr. Mahipal and based in Al Quoz, we design and build villas, apartments, and commercial spaces across the city, from Damac Hills to Murooj Al Furjan. Our work as an interior design company in Dubai is best judged by the people who live in it, and our clients say so on camera.

One team, one vision; building your space the way you like. PC interiors, an Interior Design Company in Dubai that brings every element of interior architecture together. Residential or commercial, we shape spaces of quiet luxury. With turnkey interior design, landscaping, joinery and carpentry together under one in-house team, every detail is crafted with precision.
